# Keerthana Yalamanchili

> Senior Delivery Leader.

Keerthana Yalamanchili is a Senior Delivery Leader with 9+ years of experience driving enterprise transformation across retail, store operations, omnichannel customer experience and digital platforms. She directed MYER's $3M Multi-Factor Authentication program, led a $1M, 8-month IoT/location tracking initiative with a 30% reduction in store equipment losses, reduced enterprise release deployment windows from 4 days to 1 hour and cut path-to-production lead times from 2 days to under 1 hour. She also contributed to 120,000+ annual team-member hours saved across Bunnings Group. Her experience: Senior Delivery Lead at Bunnings Group (May 2024 to Present), Iteration Manager / Program Delivery Lead at MYER (March 2022 to March 2024), Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager at OptiRise Software (May 2021 to December 2021), Co-Founder at Mappstack (May 2020 to May 2021) and Project Systems Administrator / PMO & Technology Delivery at BDP International a.k.a PSA BDP (June 2017 to April 2020). She holds a Master of Management Information Systems, a Bachelor of Technology (Engineering), ICP-APM, Certified ScrumMaster and Professional Scrum Master. Based in Melbourne, VIC. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/keey
